scripts.voiceover: for c in full short ep1 ep2 ep3 ep4 ep5 returns; do python3 scripts/voiceover.py $c || exit 1; done && python3 scripts/plan_series.py
scripts.render: npm run render:full && npm run render:short
scripts.render:full: remotion render BukAmPromoFull out/bukam-promo-full-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/bukam-promo-full-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/bukam-promo-full-49s.mp4
scripts.render:short: remotion render BukAmPromo out/bukam-promo-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/bukam-promo-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/bukam-promo-30s.mp4
scripts.render:series: remotion render SoundFamiliar1 out/sound-familiar-1-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/sound-familiar-1-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/sound-familiar-1.mp4 && remotion render SoundFamiliar2 out/sound-familiar-2-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/sound-familiar-2-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/sound-familiar-2.mp4 && remotion render SoundFamiliar3 out/sound-familiar-3-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/sound-familiar-3-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/sound-familiar-3.mp4 && remotion render SoundFamiliar4 out/sound-familiar-4-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/sound-familiar-4-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/sound-familiar-4.mp4 && remotion render SoundFamiliar5 out/sound-familiar-5-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/sound-familiar-5-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/sound-familiar-5.mp4
scripts.render:returns: remotion render BukAmReturnables out/bukam-returnables-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/bukam-returnables-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/bukam-returnables.mp4
scripts.render:all: npm run render && npm run render:series && npm run render:returns
